transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I've called this signoff meeting because we have a production planning to film interior scenes at the Calder Theater this Thursday night, and before I can issue the venue authorization, I need to go through the routine location-and-insurance signoff with each of you. The draft production plan calls for equipment to come in through the freight elevator, 24 crew members working in the theater, ordinary floor covering, and a 12:00 AM wrap. Before I can finalize anything, I need each participating owner to submit a formal, fact-specific report of their verified conditions — a general acknowledgment won't suffice. So let's start hearing from each of you on your conditions and concerns.
